title: Add optional login, notifications, and download features

requirements.summary: Implement optional Internet Identity login that allows browsing without authentication and shows login status in header
acceptanceCriteria: Users can view all poetry content without logging in
Login button is visible in header for unauthenticated users
Logged-in users see their authentication status in header
All existing browsing functionality (collections, search, poem viewing) works without authentication

file_operations.description: Add LoginButton component to header that displays authentication status and allows login/logout. Use the authorization component to handle Internet Identity authentication. Position the login button prominently in the header navigation area. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a login button component using the authorization component's useInternetIdentity hook and following the login component pattern from the authorization usage instructions. Handle login/logout flows with proper state management and query cache clearing on logout. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a modal component for first-time user profile setup that asks for the user's name using the authorization component's profile setup pattern. Use getCallerUserProfile and saveCallerUserProfile backend methods. Implement proper loading states to prevent modal flash as described in authorization usage instructions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add UserProfileSetup component to the app root level to handle first-time user profile creation after login. The modal should only appear when a logged-in user has no profile set up.

Add React Query hooks for user profile operations: useGetCallerUserProfile, useSaveCallerUserProfile, and useGetUserProfile. Follow the authorization component's pattern for preventing profile setup modal flash with proper actor dependency handling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add in-app notification system that displays alerts to logged-in users when new poetry is added
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tracks when new poems are added with timestamps
Backend provides endpoint to fetch notifications for logged-in users
Frontend displays notification badge or icon when new poetry is available
Notifications are only visible to authenticated users
Users can view and clear their notifications

file_operations.description: Add NotificationBell component to header that displays unread notification count badge for authenticated users only. Position it near the login button in the header navigation area.

Create notification bell icon component with badge showing unread count using useGetUnreadNotificationsCount hook. Only render for authenticated users. Clicking opens the NotificationPanel component. Use shadcn/ui Button and Badge components for consistent styling.

Create dropdown panel component that displays list of notifications fetched from useGetNotifications hook. Show notification message and timestamp formatted with formatDate utility. Provide mark-as-read functionality using useMarkNotificationAsRead hook. Use shadcn/ui DropdownMenu components for the panel UI.

Add React Query hooks for notification operations: useGetNotifications to fetch notification list, useGetUnreadNotificationsCount to get unread count, and useMarkNotificationAsRead mutation to mark individual notifications as read. Invalidate notification queries after marking as read to update the UI.

requirements.summary: Add download button for image-type poems that enables direct image file download
acceptanceCriteria: Download button appears on poem detail page for image-type poems
Clicking download button triggers browser download of the poem image
Downloaded file has appropriate filename based on poem title or ID
Download works for all existing image poems

file_operations.description: Add download button for image-type poems that triggers browser download using the ExternalBlob's getDirectURL method and creates an anchor element to initiate download. Generate filename from poem title (sanitized) or poem ID. Position button below the image display area.

Create utility functions for downloading files: downloadImageFromURL that accepts URL and filename, creates temporary anchor element, triggers download, and cleans up. Include filename sanitization function to create valid filenames from poem titles.

requirements.summary: Add download button for text-type poems that converts text into an attractive image format and downloads it
acceptanceCriteria: Download button appears on poem detail page for text-type poems
Text content is rendered into an attractive image format with appropriate styling
Generated image includes poem text, author name, and branding
Clicking download button triggers browser download of the generated image
Image format maintains readability and visual appeal

file_operations.description: Add download button for text-type poems that calls the generatePoemImage function to convert poem text into image format and triggers download. Position button below the text content display area, matching the placement of image download button.

Create function to generate attractive poster-style image from text poem using HTML5 Canvas API. Render poem text, author name, and 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' branding with appropriate typography and styling. Use warm earth tone colors from the theme. Return canvas as blob for download. Include proper text wrapping and formatting for readability.
Add downloadBlobAsImage function that accepts a blob and filename, creates object URL, triggers browser download via anchor element, and revokes object URL after download.

requirements.summary: Update website title and branding from 'International Gojri Maa Booli Adab' to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab'
acceptanceCriteria: Browser tab title displays 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab'
Header component displays 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab'
Spelling change from 'Booli' to 'Boli' is applied consistently across all branding locations

file_operations.description: Update the document title tag from 'International Gojri Maa Booli Adab' to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' to correct the spelling in the browser tab.
Update the header branding text from 'International Gojri Maa Booli Adab' to 'International Gojri Maa Boli Adab' to correct the spelling in the site header.
